bull.b: Preclinical validation of a masked tri-specific T-cell engager that improves safety and shows strong anti-tumor activity creates a durable platform advantage. A platform that enables tumor-selective activation and dual T/NK engagement can support multiple candidates, boost partnership value, and increase long-term optionality if clinical proof emerges.

bull.t: Scientific Advisory Board with clinical leaders
bull.b: A SAB of clinicians and scientists with first-in-class TCE experience materially strengthens translational strategy and trial design. That expertise reduces execution risk, improves go/no-go clinical decisions, and enhances credibility with partners and investors—benefits that persist across development cycles.

Very small debt levels reduce fixed financial obligations and give management flexibility to prioritize R&D or negotiate licensing deals without immediate interest burden. Low leverage improves resilience to trial delays or financing cycles and preserves strategic optionality over the medium term.

bear.t: No meaningful revenue and persistent losses
bear.b: With virtually no revenue and repeated large net losses, Purple Biotech remains fully pre-revenue and dependent on external financing or partner deals. This structural state increases dilution risk, constrains reinvestment capacity, and means commercial sustainability hinges entirely on future clinical success or licensing outcomes.

A small cash balance providing runway only into H1 2027 creates a durable financing requirement ahead of first-in-human trials. Needing capital before key clinical inflection increases the likelihood of dilutive financings or hurried partnerships that can alter strategic control and returns over the long term.

bear.t: Negative operating cash flow and equity erosion
bear.b: Sustained negative OCF and a steep drop in equity reflect ongoing cash burn and capital depletion. Over months this increases refinancing frequency and reduces bargaining power with partners or acquirers, raising structural execution risk for costly clinical development programs absent material external funding.
